newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sanofi outperform on alliance talks.
newsitem.headline: Sanofi outperform on alliance talks.

text.p: Shares of French pharmaceutical and beauty products company Sanofi outperformed on Monday on the back of comments by its chief about its quest for a merger partner.
At 1301 GMT, the shares were up 2.31 percent at 531 francs on volume of 80,196 shares while the CAC-40 index of 40 leading shares was 0.67 percent higher.

Chairman Jean-Francois Dehecq said in a newspaper interview that last month's announcement by company parent Elf that it wanted Sanofi to find a merger partner to boost its profitability gave it "greater development potential".
